pr_title: Create zone bypass switches for DSC panels
pr_body:
<!--

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
The `envisalink` integration will now create switch entities that represent the bypass state of each zone on a DSC alarm panel.  The switches can be used to bypass individual zones before arming the alarm.

These switches will not be created for Honeywell panels as it is not supported by the underlying API.

These changes depend on https://github.com/Cinntax/pyenvisalink/commit/e63e75ad300d67bbb7ccec71eee184af7c42d946 included in `pyenvisalink` version `4.3`.

Changelog: https://github.com/Cinntax/pyenvisalink/compare/4.0...4.3

review_comments: Don't pass in `hass`. It will be set on the entity when the entity has been added to home assistant. This means you can access `hass` with `self.hass`, after the entity has been added to home assistant.
